name: Adaptive Subdivision in DiffTetVR
definition: A training strategy that refines the tetrahedral mesh by subdividing vertices with high color gradients to increase resolution where needed, aiming to solve the issue of wasted resolution in empty regions.
summary: Adaptive Subdivision in DiffTetVR is a training strategy that refines tetrahedral meshes using color gradients and a CSP solver to increase resolution in high-detail regions while maintaining topological compatibility.
